verdict.rationale: The REST API genuinely exposes nexus status, registrations, filings, and exemption records (kintsugi-docs-11/12/13/14/35/38) and can be reached with an org-scoped, expiring API key (kintsugi-docs-5/17/27/28), so an agent can read and act on tax posture via the API. But the official MCP surface explicitly does not provide this access: Kintsugi's own docs state the MCP server 'doesn't need your API key... never proxies calls to the API and never sees your credentials' and only serves public docs/OpenAPI content (kintsugi-docs-30), directly narrowing the broader 'AI assistants can understand Kintsugi's endpoints... provide context-aware help' framing (kintsugi-docs-6/29). So the MCP-with-scoped-credentials half of the story is unsupported/contradicted by Kintsugi's own documentation. Missing for 10: an MCP or agent-facing surface that actually reads/acts on live nexus, registration, liability and filing data with scoped credentials (today MCP is docs-only), and any fine-grained (vs. org-wide) credential scoping.
